name: UpdateDIAlarmRule

parameters.help_en: The description of the alert rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The metric type in the alert rule. Valid values:

- Heartbeat

- FailoverCount

- Delay

- DdlReport

- ResourceUtilization
parameters.help_zh:
告警指标类型，可选的枚举值：
- Heartbeat（任务状态报警）
- FailoverCount（failover次数报警）
- Delay（任务延迟报警）
- DdlReport: DDL通知
- ResourceUtilization： 资源组使用率
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. By default, the alert rule is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则是否启用，默认不开启
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization task
parameters.name: di_job_id

element_fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

- Warning

- Critical
element_fields.name: severity

element_fields.help_en: The time interval for alert calculation. Unit: minutes
element_fields.help_zh: 告警计算时间区间，单位分钟
element_fields.name: duration

element_fields.help_en:
The alert threshold.

- If the alert rule is for task status, you do not need to specify a threshold.

- If the alert rule is for failovers, you must specify the number of failovers.

- If the alert rule is for latency, you must specify the latency duration, in seconds
element_fields.help_zh:
告警阈值。

- 任务状态报警：无需填写阈值。
- failover次数报警：阈值为failover次数。
- 任务延迟报警：阈值为延迟时长，单位秒
element_fields.name: threshold

element_fields.help_en: The types of DDL operations for which the alert rule takes effect
element_fields.help_zh: 在DDL通知的时候才生效，需要生效的DDL列表
element_fields.name: ddl_types

element_fields.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the DdlTypes parameter
element_fields.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用DdlTypes字段
element_fields.name: ddl_report_tags

parameters.help_en: The conditions that can trigger the alert rule
parameters.help_zh: 告警触发条件列表，支持多条件
parameters.name: trigger_conditions

element_fields.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

- Warning

- Critical
element_fields.help_zh:
严重程度，可选的枚举值：
- Warning
- Critical
element_fields.name: severity

element_fields.help_en:
The alert notification method. Valid values:

- Mail

- Phone

- Sms

- Ding
element_fields.help_zh:
通道，可选的枚举值：
- Mail（邮件）
- Phone（电话）
- Sms（短信）
- Ding（钉钉）
element_fields.name: channels

element_fields.help_en: The recipient type. Valid values: AliyunUid, DingToken, FeishuToken, and WebHookUrl
element_fields.name: receiver_type

element_fields.help_en:
The recipient.

- If the ReceiverType parameter is set to AliyunUid, set this parameter to the Alibaba Cloud account ID of a user.

- If the ReceiverType parameter is set to DingToken, set this parameter to the token of a DingTalk chatbot
element_fields.help_zh:
接收方取值。

- 当接收方类型为阿里云ID时，接收方取值为具体阿里云用户ID。
- 当接收方类型为钉钉token时，接收方取值为具体钉钉token值
element_fields.name: receiver_values

fields.help_en: The settings of alert notification recipients
fields.name: notification_receivers

fields.help_en: The duration of the alert suppression interval. Default value: 5. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 告警抑制间隔时长，单位分钟，默认5分钟
fields.name: mute_interval

fields.help_en: This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the MuteInterval parameter
fields.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用MuteInterval进行配置
fields.name: inhibition_interval

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the Id parameter instead
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用Id字段
parameters.name: di_alarm_rule_id
